SUBJECT: The Central Military Academy of the Nanking Government

With reference to the attached news item appearing in the "Shanghai Times", dated July 21, 1941, enquiries show that in order to educate junior officers in its army, the Nanking Government has established a Central Military Academy (中央陸軍軍官學校) at the former site of the Moral Endeavour Society (Li Ts Zoe 勵志社) (Chungking Government), Chung Shan Tung Road (中山東路), Nanking. Enrollment for 1,000 students for the military institution which is to take place in Nanking, Canton, Hankow and Peiping will commence on July 25 and end on August 5.

Able-bodied young men between the ages of 18 and 25, who have graduated from a senior middle school or with the equivalent education, are eligible to send in their applications for permission to take part in the entrance examination, which will take place from August 6 to 13.

After being taken on as a cadet of the Academy, a monthly allowance of $8 will be granted to him, in addition to free lodging, board, uniforms etc. The cadets will first be detailed to undergo practical exercises with the various army units in Nanking for a period of six months, after which they will be sent to the Central Military Academy. After a one-and-a-half years' course, they will graduate from the military institution and be appointed to the Army of the Nanking Government as officers in charge of a platoon or company.

主题：南京政府中央陆军军官学校

关于附上的1941年7月21日《上海泰晤士报》刊登的新闻剪报，经查询显示，为了培养其军队中的初级军官，南京政府已在南京中山东路原励志社（重庆国民政府）旧址成立了一所中央陆军军官学校（中央陸軍軍官學校）。该军事院校将在南京、广州、汉口和北平招收1,000名学生，报名将于7月25日开始，至8月5日结束。

年龄在18至25岁之间、身体健康且已高中毕业或具有同等学历的青年男子，有资格提交申请参加入学考试，考试将于8月6日至13日举行。

被录取为军校学员后，除免费食宿、制服等外，每月还将发放8元津贴。学员将首先被派往南京各部队进行为期六个月的实地演习，之后将被送往中央陆军军官学校。经过一年半的课程学习后，他们将从该军事院校毕业，并被任命为南京政府军队中的排长或连长。

Made by. D.I. Pan Lien Pih Forwarded by. D.I. Crawford

E (2)

The some 300 officers who are receiving a three months' course of training in the Wang Ching Wei sponsored "Central Military Officers' Training Corps", Yoo Ping Road, Kiangwan, have completed the course. A graduation ceremony was held at 10 a.m. February 20, 1940, in the auditorium of the Corps. Among the attendants were Wang Ching Wei (汪精衛), Chu Min Yi (褚民), Ling Pah Sung (林柏生), Chow Hwa Zung (周化人), Mei Sz Ping (梅思平), Liu Yoh Feng (刘郁芬) and about 50 Chinese and Japanese guests, who were received by Colonel Yeh Peng (葉蓬), instructor of the Corps.

Wang Ching Wei acting as chairman of the function gave a lecture appropriate to the occasion. Lectures were also given by some of the officials abovementioned. Diplomas and prizes were then presented by Wang Ching Wei. After a group photo had been taken, the meeting concluded at 11.30 a.m..

It is reported that this batch of graduates will be given commissions as lieutenants and majors in the so-called "Peace and National Reconstruction Army" (和平建國軍), which is being established by Wang Ching Wei for the purpose of garrisoning Nanking and the various railway systems.

在江湾幽萍路（音译）(Yoo Ping Road)，由汪精卫赞助的“中央军官训练团”中接受为期三个月培训的约300名军官已完成课程。1940年2月20日上午10时，在该团礼堂举行了毕业典礼。出席者包括汪精卫（汪精衛）、褚民谊（褚民）、林柏生（林柏生）、周化人（周化人）、梅思平（梅思平）、刘郁芬（刘郁芬）以及约50名中日宾客，由该团教官叶蓬上校（葉蓬）接待。

汪精卫作为活动主席发表了切合场合的演讲。上述部分官员也发表了讲话。随后，汪精卫颁发了文凭和奖品。合影后，会议于上午11时30分结束。

No. S. B. D.
Date January 16, 19 40.

Subject... Liu Woo Hsiung - member of Central Military Officers'
Training Corps.

Made by/ and Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

On the morning of January 15, 1940, D.S.I.
Smith of Louza Station brought to the Police
Headquarters one named Lin Woo Hsiung (劉武),
who was dressed in a military uniform.

From questioning, he admitted that he was
a member of the Central Military Officers' Training
Corps (陸軍軍官訓練團), Civic Centre, and
was attached to the Adjutants' Office with the rank
of Captain, but refused to divulge further particulars
of the corps on the grounds that they were a military
secret.

At 11 a.m. the same day Mr. Ling Tuh Yuan
(凌德源) alias Ling Wei Chien (凌滙泉), chief
adjutant of the corps, arrived at Police Headquarters
with a despatch letter requesting the handing over of
this man. He was apparently absent without leave
and would be disciplined. The despatch is attached
to this report with translation.

On the instruction of A.C. (Special Branch),
Liu Woo Hsiung was handed over to Mr. Ling Tuh Yuan.

D. I.

A. C. ( Special Branch ).

Central Military Corps
Cadets And Barracks In
Kiangwan Are Inspected

General Yeh Peng, Dean Of Central Military
Officers' Training Corps, Leads Foreign
Guests On Tour Of Spacious Barracks

SMART APPEARANCE AND EXCELLENT
EQUIPMENT COMMENTED UPON

Presenting a smart appearance as they lined up in front of their barracks, the officers and cadets of the Central Military Officers' Training Corps in Kiangwan, were viewed for the first time yesterday by foreign observers and correspondents. The occasion was a special military review and inspection arranged by General Yeh Peng, Dean of the Training Corps.

Wearing almost new uniforms, their buttons shining in the sunlight, and generally presenting a good appearance, the cadets made a very favourable impression on some 60 invited guests, who travelled to Kiangwan yesterday morning to inspect the new training institution and its personnel.

Situated not far from the Kiang-wan Race Course and adjoining Japanese Army barracks, the barracks of the Central Military Officers' Training Corps occupy a very large plot of ground. There are several large buildings used as dormitories, as headquarters and a large assembly hall, where a speech was made yesterday by General Yeh Peng, standing before a dias, behind which hung a picture of the late Dr. Sun Yat-sen with Kuomintang flags on each side.

Upon being met by General Yeh Peng and Dr. Tsu Min-yee, the guests were led into the barracks, as the band struck up a lively military tune. After inspecting the troops the guests were led on a tour of the large and airy barracks. One and all were surprised at the neatness and cleanliness of the barrack rooms.

General's Speech

In welcoming the guests in a large auditorium, which was also filled with cadets, General Yeh Peng did so on behalf of Mr. Wang Ching-wei, the members of the Training Staff and the officers and cadets under training.

During his address General Yeh Peng outlined the purpose of the training corps and pointed out that soon after inauguration there were no more vacancies and at present there is a waiting list for admittance. Mr. H. G. W. Woodhead, c.b.e., editor of "Oriental Affairs," replied on behalf of the foreign guests, Mr. Shinji Shimaya, correspondent of the "Manshu Nichi-Nichi" (Manchoukuo), responded on behalf of the Japanese guests.

Among the guests present were Colonel Homero Principini, Italian Military Attache; Mr. R. Jobez, Deputy Commissioner of the French Municipal Police; Mr. Kuo Hsiu-keng, editor-in-chief of the "Chung Hua Min Pao." Mr. Wang Ching-wei's organ, foreign correspondents and local press representatives.

In welcoming the guests General Yeh Peng said:

"We are greatly honoured by your presence here to-day, and on behalf of our President, Mr. Wang Ching-wei, the members of the Training Staff and the officers and cadets under training, I take pleasure in welcoming you one and all.

The military review which you have just witnessed is but a rudimentary example of what this military institution is aiming to achieve. Our equipment and educational facilities are not yet up to the proper standard of a really modern army, and what you have seen to-day is the result of our efforts of only two and a half weeks of training. Much still needs improvement, but I hope that we have not been working in vain, for even the partial success which we have achieved in difficult circumstances is very encouraging for the future.

Three Points

"The establishment of this Institution and its future growth will not be due so much to our own personal efforts; they are primarily dependent on three things—the correctness of our principles, the greatness of our Leader, and the spirit of Sino-Japanese Co-operation.

"1.—The fundamental principles of this Institution are peace, Anti-Communism and National Reconstruction, as expounded in the Manifesto and Revised Programme of the Sixth National Congress of the Kuomintang. The young officers and cadets have rallied joyfully to our cause; they have been arriving in such large numbers that the maximum number of candidates has long already been exceeded; and all late arrivals have been informed that they would have to be patient and wait for their turn. This definitely proves that the principles of Peace, Anti-Communism and National Reconstruction are forcefully appealing to our people and are taking root in the Chinese youth of to-day; they are China's immutable and permanent national policies for generation to come.

"2.—The moral and spiritual power of our Leader is irresistible. For although the principles of Peace, Anti-Communism and National Reconstruction are correct, without Mr. Wang Ching-wei's moral prestige and spiritual power, his initiative and guidance, I feel certain that this Institution would not have been able to boast of even a handful of officers whose duties it will be to uphold the principles which will lead to the salvation of the nation.

Japanese Co-operation

"Last, but not least, we must praise the spirit of Sino-Japanese Co-operation, which is binding two natural enemies into natural friends again. This Institution has received many benefits from the Japanese authorities who have helped us in every way possible. We owe them a debt of gratitude which we can never repay.

living reality. Once Sino-Japanese friendship has ousted the hatred existing between the two nations and is re-established upon mutual sincerity, our friendship will be everlasting, to the benefit not only of China and Japan, but of the Far East and the world in general.

"The officers and cadets of this Institution are patriots. Young in years, but they have the experience of their elders. Have they not witnessed the ravages caused to their mother-country by Bolshevism? Are they blind to what Bolshevism has in store for the rest of the world? Can world peace remain permanently undisturbed after what Bolshevism has done to the Chinese Republic? These young true patriots of China are therefore not without reason antagonistic to Bolshevism. They are also aware that should the Sino-Japanese War continue to drag on, both China and Japan will just destroy one another with the result that the Communists will have no difficulty in tearing them to pieces with their rapacious claws. Consequently, they are convinced that Anti-Communism must be put into practice, but before this is possible, peace must be made. But in order to secure permanent peace in the world and the co-existence and co-prosperity of our respective countries, it is essential for us to join hand in hand to resist our common enemy and to unroot the menace to civilization as manifested in Bolshevik Communism.

"Therefore, all the staff members of this Institution, together with the officers and cadets, have joined together to carry out the Three People's Principles under the leadership of Mr. Wang Ching-wei. We are dedicating our bodies and souls to our Leader with the object of accomplishing our mission of Peace, Anti-Communism and National Reconstruction!

"In conclusion, I wish to thank you for honouring us with your presence here to-day, and I hope you will be good enough to convey the goodwill which the true China is bearing your respective countries."

中央军官团
江湾学员及营房接受检阅

中央陆军军官训练团教务长叶蓬将军率领外宾参观宽敞的营房

仪容整齐与装备精良获好评

江湾中央陆军军官训练团的军官和学员在营房前列队，仪容整齐，昨日首次接受了外国观察员和记者的检阅。此次活动是由该训练团教务长叶蓬将军安排的一次特别军事校阅和视察。

学员们身着几乎全新的制服，纽扣在阳光下闪闪发光，整体形象良好，给昨天上午前往江湾视察这一新培训机构及其人员的约60位受邀嘉宾留下了非常良好的印象。

中央陆军军官训练团的营房位于江湾赛马场不远处，毗邻日军营房，占据了一大片土地。这里有几座大型建筑，用作宿舍、总部和一个大型礼堂，叶蓬将军昨天就在该礼堂发表了演讲，他站在讲台前，身后悬挂着孙中山博士的遗像，两侧配有国民党党旗。

在叶蓬将军和褚民谊博士（Dr. Tsu Min-yee）的迎接下，宾客们在乐队奏起欢快的军乐声中被引入营房。在检阅部队后，宾客们被带领参观了宽敞明亮的营房。所有人都对营房的整洁和干净感到惊讶。

将军演讲

在一个坐满学员的大型礼堂里欢迎宾客时，叶蓬将军代表汪精卫先生、训练团成员以及受训军官和学员致欢迎辞。

在讲话中，叶蓬将军概述了训练团的宗旨，并指出在成立后不久就没有空缺名额了，目前还有等候入学的名单。《东方事务》（Oriental Affairs）编辑 H. G. W. Woodhead 爵士（C.B.E.）代表外宾致辞，《满洲日日新闻》（Manchoukuo）记者岛屋信二（Shinji Shimaya）先生代表日方宾客致辞。

出席的宾客包括意大利武官霍梅罗·普林西皮尼（Homero Principini）上校、法国公董局警务处副总巡捕 R. Jobez 先生、汪精卫机关报《中华民报》总编辑郭秀庚先生，以及外国通讯员和当地新闻界代表。

叶蓬将军在欢迎宾客时说：

“各位今日莅临，我们深感荣幸，我谨代表我们的主席汪精卫先生、训练团成员以及受训军官和学员，热烈欢迎各位。

各位刚才目睹的军事校阅，只是本军事机构旨在实现的目标的一个初步范例。我们的装备和教育设施尚未达到真正现代化军队的适当标准，而各位今天所看到的，仅仅是我们两周半训练努力的结果。尚有许多地方需要改进，但我希望我们的努力并非徒劳，因为即使在困难的环境下取得的_partial_成功，也对未来非常鼓舞人心。

三点

“本机构的建立及其未来的发展，与其说是依靠我们个人的努力，不如说主要取决于三件事——我们原则的正确性、我们领袖的伟大，以及中日合作的精神。

“1.——本机构的基本原则是和平、反共和建国，正如国民党第六次全国代表大会宣言和修正纲领中所阐述的那样。年轻军官和学员欢欣鼓舞地聚集在我们的事业周围；他们到来的人数如此之多，以至于早已超过了最大候选人数额；所有后来者都被告知必须耐心等待轮候。这确凿地证明，和平、反共和建国的原则有力地吸引着我国人民，并在当今的中国青年中扎根；它们是中国世世代代不可改变和永久性的国策。

“2.——我们领袖的道德和精神力量是不可阻挡的。因为虽然和平、反共和建国的原则是正确的，但如果没有汪精卫先生的道德威望和精神力量，没有他的倡议和指导，我确信本机构甚至无法拥有少数几名致力于维护将导致国家拯救之原则的军官。

日本的合作

“最后但同样重要的是，我们必须赞扬中日合作的精神，这种精神正将两个天敌再次变为天然的朋友。本机构从日本当局那里获益良多，他们在各方面都给予了我们帮助。我们欠他们一份永远无法偿还的感激之情。

活生生的现实。一旦中日友谊驱除了两国之间存在的仇恨，并在相互真诚的基础上重新建立，我们的友谊将永存，这不仅有利于中国和日本，也有利于远东乃至整个世界。

“本机构的军官和学员都是爱国者。他们虽然年轻，却拥有长者般的经验。难道他们没有目睹布尔什维克主义给祖国造成的破坏吗？他们对布尔什维克主义为世界其他地区准备的命运视而不见吗？在布尔什维克主义对中华民国所做的一切之后，世界和平还能保持永久不受干扰吗？因此，这些中国年轻的真正爱国者反对布尔什维克主义并非没有理由。他们也意识到，如果中日战争继续拖延下去，中国和日本只会互相毁灭，结果共产主义者将毫不费力地用他们贪婪的爪子将它们撕碎。因此，他们坚信必须实行反共，但在此之前，必须实现和平。但是，为了确保世界永久和平以及我们各自国家的共存与共荣，我们必须携手抵抗共同的敌人，并根除以布尔什维克共产主义形式表现的文明威胁。

“因此，本机构全体工作人员，连同军官和学员，团结在汪精卫先生的领导下，共同践行三民主义。我们将身心奉献给我们的领袖，以完成我们和平、反共和建国的使命！

“最后，我要感谢各位今日光临，使我们要增光不少，并希望各位能将真实的中国对贵国所怀有的善意传达回去。”

Subject :- Visit of foreign journalists to Wang Ching
Wei's Central Army Cadet Corps directed by
General Yeh Pong.

On January 6, foreign and pro-Japanese Chinese
journalists visited the Central Army's Cadet Corps ( ), the new military college of Wang Ching Wei, the
inauguration of which was reported on December 15, 1939.

The programme was as follows :-

8.30 a.m. Assembling at North Gate of Hongkew Park.
9.00 a.m. Arrival at locale.
9.15 a.m. Inspection of "Corps".
9.30 a.m. Review.
10.00a.m. Visit to barracks.
10.30a.m. Speech by General.Yeh Pong ( ),
director of the school.
11.00a.m. Refreshments.

The guests were slightly embarrassed in their
endeavours to reach the assembly point arranged for them.
Traffic in North Szechuen Road and cross roads was stopped
from 8 a.m. to 10 a.m. by the Japanese Naval Landing Party,
and vehicles proceeding to the ceremony had to make a detour
via Chapei.

It was later learned that the stopping of traffic
in North Szechuen Road was due to a rehearsal of the parade
of the Landing Party, arranged for January 7 and that the
Japanese authorities did not know that the inspection of the
cadets was to have taken place.

The guests proceeded in processional order to the
school which occupies the old Japanese barracks between
Tasang and Kiangwan. There they were received by General
Yeh Pong, director of the School, and Dr. Chu Ming Yee

主题：外国记者参观由叶蓬将军指挥的汪精卫中央陆军军官学校。

1月6日，外国及亲华日籍记者参观了中央陆军军官学校（ ），这是汪精卫的新军事学院，其落成典礼曾于1939年12月15日报道过。

日程安排如下：

上午8:30 在虹口公园北门集合。
上午9:00 抵达现场。
上午9:15 检阅“军校”。
上午9:30 阅兵。
上午10:00 参观营房。
上午10:30 校长叶蓬将军（ ）致辞。
上午11:00 茶点招待。

客人们在前往为他们安排的集合点时略感尴尬。从上午8点到10点，日本海军陆战队封锁了北四川路及其交叉路口的交通，前往参加典礼的车辆不得不绕道闸北。

后来得知，北四川路的交通中断是因为日本陆战队正在为定于1月7日举行的阅兵式进行排练，且日本当局并不知道当天将举行学员检阅活动。

客人们列队前往位于大场和江湾之间的旧日本兵营内的学校。在那里，他们受到了该校校长叶蓬将军和代表汪精卫先生的褚民谊博士

page_data.en:
GENERAL YEH-PENG'S ADDRESS.

Gentlemen :-

We are greatly honoured by your presence here today,
and on behalf of our President, Mr. Wang Ching-wei, the
members of the Training Staff and the officers and cadets
under training, I take pleasure in welcoming you one and
all.

The military review which you have just witnessed is
but a rudimentary example of what this military institution
is aiming to achieve. Our equipment and educational faci-
lities are not yet up to the proper standard of a really
modern army, and what you have seen today is the result
of our efforts of only two and a half months of prepara-
tion and four weeks of training. Much still needs improve-
ment but I hope that we have not been working in vain, for
even the partial success which we have achieved in diffi-
cult circumstances is very encouraging for the future.

The establishment of this Institution and its future
growth will not be due so much to our own personal efforts;
they are primarily dependent on three things -- the cor-
rectness of our principles, the greatness of our Leader,
and the spirit of Sino-Japanese co-operation.
1. The fundamental principles of this Institution are
peace, Anti-Communism and National Reconstruction, as expoun-
ded in the Manifesto and Revised Programme of the Sixth
National Congress of the Kuo-Min Tang. The young officers
and cadets have rallied joyfully to our cause; they have
been arriving in such large numbers that the maximum num-
ber of candidates has long already been exceeded; and
all late arrivals have been informed that they would have
to be patient and wait for their turn. This definitely
proves that the principles of Peace, Anti-Communism and
National Reconstruction are forcefully appealing to our peo-
ple and are taking root in the Chinese youth of to-day;
they are China's immutable and permanent national policies
for generation to come.
2. The moral and spiritual power of our Leader is ir-
resistible. For although the principles of Peace, Anti-
Communism and National Reconstruction are correct, without
Mr. Wang Ching-Wei's moral prestige and spiritual power,
his initiative and guidance, I feel certain that this
Institution would not have been able to boast of even a
handful of officers whose duties it will be to uphold
the only principles which will lead to the salvation of
the nation.
page_data.zh:
叶蓬将军致辞。

诸位先生：

各位今日莅临，我们深感荣幸。我谨代表我校总裁汪精卫先生、全体教职员以及受训军官和学员，向各位表示热烈欢迎。

各位刚才目睹的军事检阅，仅是本军事机构追求目标的初步展示。我们的装备和教育设施尚未达到真正现代化军队的适当标准，而各位今日所见，仅仅是我们两个半月准备工作和四周训练的成果。虽仍有诸多需要改进之处，但我希望我们的努力并非徒劳，因为在艰难环境下取得的哪怕部分成功，也对未来极具鼓舞作用。

本机构的建立及其未来发展，并非主要归功于我们个人的努力；它们主要取决于三件事——我们原则的正确性、我们领袖的伟大，以及中日合作的精神。
1. 本机构的根本原则是和平、反共和建国，正如国民党第六次全国代表大会宣言和修正纲领中所阐述的那样。青年军官和学员欢欣鼓舞地响应我们的事业；前来报名的人数众多，早已超过最大名额限制；所有迟来者均被告知需耐心等待轮候。这确凿地证明，和平、反共和建国的原则有力地吸引着我国人民，并在当今中国青年中扎根；它们是中国世代相传的不可更改的永久国策。
2. 我们领袖的道德和精神力量是不可阻挡的。因为虽然和平、反共和建国的原则是正确的，但若无汪精卫先生的道德威望和精神力量，若无他的倡议和指导，我确信本机构甚至无法拥有少数几名致力于维护唯一能拯救国家原则的军官。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

3. Last, but not least, we must emphasize the spirit
of Sino-Japanese Co-operation which is turning two unnatural
enemies into natural friends again. This Institution has
enjoyed many courtesies from the Japanese authorities who
have had in contributing to the success of this Institution.
We are translating this spirit of co-operation into a living
reality. Once Sino-Japanese friendship has ousted the hatred
existing between the two nations and is re-established upon
mutual sincerity, our friendship will be everlasting, to the
benefit not only of China and Japan, but of the Far East and
the World in general.

The officers and cadets of this Institution are pa-
triots. Young in years, but they have the experience of their
elders. Have they not witnessed the ravages caused to their
mother-country by Bolshevism ? Are they blind to what Bolshe-
vism has in store for the rest of the world? Can world peace
remain permanently undisturbed after what Bolshevism has
done to the Chinese Republic? These young true patriots of
China are therefore not without reason antagonistic to
Bolshevism. They are also aware that should the Sino-Japanese
War continue to drag on, both China and Japan will just des-
troy one another with the result that the Communists will have
no difficulty in tearing them to pieces with their rapacious
claws. Consequently, they are convinced that Anti-Communism
must be put into practice, but before this is possible,
Peace must be made. But in order to secure permanent peace
in the world and the co-existence and co-prosperity of our
respective countries, it is essential for us to join hand in
hand to resist our common enemy and to uproot the menace to
civilization as manifested in Bolshevik Communism.

Therefore all the staff members of this Institution,
together with the officers and cadets, have joined together
to carry out the Three People's Principles under the leader-
ship of Mr. Wang Ching-Wei. We are dedicating our bodies
and souls to our leader with the object of accomplishing our
mission of Peace, Anti-communism and National Reconstruction!

In conclusion, I wish to thank you for honouring us
with your presence here to-day, and I hope you will be good
enough to convey the goodwill which the true China is bearing
your respective countries.

3. 最后但同样重要的是，我们必须强调中日合作精神，这种精神正使两个不自然的敌人重新成为自然的朋友。本机构得到了日本当局的许多礼遇，他们在促成本机构成功方面做出了贡献。我们将这种合作精神转化为生动的现实。一旦中日友谊驱除了两国间存在的仇恨，并在相互真诚的基础上重新建立，我们的友谊将永世长存，这不仅有利于中国和日本，也有利于远东乃至整个世界。

本机构的军官和学员都是爱国者。他们年纪轻轻，却拥有长者般的经验。难道他们没有目睹布尔什维克主义给祖国造成的破坏吗？难道他们对布尔什维克主义为世界其余部分准备的命运视而不见吗？在布尔什维克主义对中华民国所做的一切之后，世界和平还能保持永久不受干扰吗？因此，这些中国真正的年轻爱国者反对布尔什维克主义是有理由的。他们也意识到，如果中日战争继续拖延下去，中国和日本只会互相毁灭，结果共产主义者将毫不费力地用他们贪婪的爪子将两国撕碎。因此，他们坚信必须实行反共，但在做到这一点之前，必须先实现和平。但是，为了确保世界永久和平以及我们各自国家的共存与共荣，我们必须携手抵抗共同敌人，并根除以布尔什维克共产主义形式表现的文明威胁。

因此，本机构全体职员连同军官和学员团结一致，在汪精卫先生的领导下实行三民主义。我们将身心奉献给我们的领袖，以完成我们和平、反共和建国的使命！

最后，我要感谢各位今日光临，增光添彩，并希望各位能将真实的中国对贵国所怀有的善意转达给各国。

officiers et de 5 mois pour les officiers suivant les
cours de perfectionnement. Les premiers quittent l'école
avec le grade de lieutenant, les autres avec celui de ca-
pitaine./.

Gentlemen :-

We are greatly honoured by your presence here today,
and on behalf of our President, Mr. Wang Ching-Wei, the
members of the Training Staff and the officers and cadets
under training, I take pleasure in welcoming you one and
all.

The military review which you have just witnessed is
but a rudimentary example of what this military institution
is aiming to achieve. Our equipment and educational facili-
ties are not yet up to the proper standard of a really
modern army, and what you have seen to-day is the result
of our efforts of only two and a half months of prepara-
tion and four weeks of training. Much still needs improve-
ment but I hope that we have not been working in vain, for
even the partial success which we have achieved in diffi-
cult circumstances is very encouraging for the future.

The establishment of this institution and its future
growth will not be due so much to our own personal ef-
forts; they are primarily dependent on three things—
the correctness of our principles, the greatness of our
Leader, and the spirit of Sino-Japanese co-operation.
1. The fundamental principles of this institution are
peace, Anti-Communism and National Reconstruction, as expe-
ded in the Manifesto and revised Programme of the Sixth
National Congress of the Kuo-Min Tang. The young officers
and cadets have rallied joyfully to our cause; they have
been arriving in such large numbers that the maximum num-
ber of candidates has long already been exceeded; and
all late arrivals have been informed that they would have
to be patient and wait for their turn. This definitely
proves that the principles of Peace, Anti-Communism and
National Reconstruction are forcefully appealing to our peo-
ple and are taking root in the Chinese youth of to-day;
they are China's immutable and permanent national policies
for generation to come.
2. The moral and spiritual power of our Leader is ir-
resistible. For although the principles of Peace, Anti-
Communism and National Reconstruction are correct, without
Mr. Wang Ching-Wei's moral prestige and spiritual power,
his initiative and guidance, I feel certain that this
institution would not have been able to boast of even a
handful of officers whose duties it will be to uphold
the only principles which will lead to the salvation of
the nation.

诸位先生：

今日蒙各位光临，我们深感荣幸。我谨代表我校总裁汪精卫先生、全体教职员以及受训军官和学员，热烈欢迎各位的到来。

各位刚才目睹的军事检阅，仅是本军事机构致力实现目标的初步展示。我们的装备和教育设施尚未达到真正现代化军队的适当标准，而各位今日所见，仅为我们两个半月准备工作和四周训练的成果。虽仍有诸多需要改进之处，但我希望我们的努力并非徒劳，因为即使在困难环境下取得的_partial_成功，也足以令我们对未来倍感鼓舞。

本机构的建立及其未来发展，并非主要归功于我们个人的努力；它们主要取决于三点——我们原则的正确性、我们领袖的伟大，以及中日合作的精神。
1. 本机构的根本原则是和平、反共与国家重建，正如中国国民党第六次全国代表大会宣言及修订纲领中所阐述的那样。青年军官和学员们欢欣鼓舞地拥护我们的事业；前来报名者人数众多，早已超过最大招生名额；所有迟来者均被告知需耐心等待轮候。这确凿地证明，和平、反共和国家重建的原则正有力地吸引着我国人民，并在当今中国青年中扎根；它们是中国世世代代不可改变和永久性的国策。
2. 我们领袖的道德和精神力量是不可抗拒的。因为虽然和平、反共和国家重建的原则是正确的，但若无汪精卫先生的道德威望和精神力量，若无他的倡议和指导，我确信本机构甚至无法拥有少数几名致力于维护唯一能引领国家走向救赎之原则的军官。

page_data.en:
3. Last, but not least, we must emphasize the spirit
of Sino-Japanese Co-operation which is turning two unnatural
enemies into natural friends again. This Institution has
enjoyed many courtesies from the Japanese authorities who
have had in contributing to the success of this institution
we are translating this spirit of co-operation into a li-
ving reality. Once Sino-Japanese friendship has ousted the
hatred existing between the two nations and is re-establi-
shed upon mutual sincerity, our friendship will be everlas-
ting, to the benefit not only of China and Japan, but of
the Far East and the world in general.

The officers and cadets of this Institution are patriotic
Young in years, but they have the experience of their elders
Have they not witnessed the ravages caused to their mother-
country by Bolshevism? Are they blind to what Bolshevism
has in store for the rest of the world? Can world peace
remain permanently undisturbed after what Bolshevism has
done to the Chinese Republic? These young true patriots of
China are therefore not without reason antagonistic to
Bolshevism. They are also aware that should the Sino-Ja-
panese war continue to drag on, both China and Japan will
just destroy one another with the result that the Commu-
nists will have no difficulty in tearing them to pieces
with their rapacious claws. Consequently, they are con-
vinced that Anti-Communism must be put into practice, but
before this is possible, Peace must be made. But in order
to secure permanent peace in the world and the co-existence
and co-prosperity of our respective countries, it is es-
sential for us to join hand in hand to resist our common
enemy and to uproot the menace to civilization as mani-
fested in Bolshevik Communism.

Therefore all the staff members of this Institution,
together with the officers and cadets, have joined toge-
ther to carry out the Three People's Principles under
the leadership of Dr. Wang Ching-Wei. We are dedicating
our bodies and souls to our leader with the object of ac-
complishing our mission of Peace, anti-communism and Na-
tional Reconstruction!

In conclusion, I wish to thank you for honouring us
with your presence here to-day, and I hope you will be
good enough to convey the goodwill which the true China
is bearing your respective countries.

3. 最后但同样重要的是，我们必须强调中日合作的精神，这种精神正将两个非自然的敌人重新变为自然的朋友。本机构得到了日本当局的许多礼遇，他们在促成本机构成功方面给予了贡献，我们将这种合作精神转化为生动的现实。一旦中日友谊驱除了两国间存在的仇恨，并在相互真诚的基础上重新建立，我们的友谊将永存，这不仅有利于中国和日本，也有利于远东乃至整个世界。

本机构的军官和学员虽然年轻，却拥有长者的经验。他们难道没有目睹布尔什维主义给祖国造成的破坏吗？他们对布尔什维主义为世界其他地区准备的命运视而不见吗？在布尔什维主义对中华民国所做的一切之后，世界和平还能保持永久不受干扰吗？因此，这些中国真正的年轻爱国者反对布尔什维主义是有理由的。他们也意识到，如果中日战争继续拖延下去，中国和日本只会互相毁灭，结果将是共产党人毫不费力地用他们贪婪的爪子将两国撕碎。因此，他们坚信必须实行反共，但在此之前，必须实现和平。但是，为了确保世界永久和平以及我们各自国家的共存与共荣，我们必须携手抵抗共同的敌人，并根除以布尔什维克共产主义形式表现的文明威胁。

因此，本机构全体教职员连同军官和学员团结一致，在汪精卫博士的领导下贯彻三民主义。我们将身心奉献给我们的领袖，以完成我们和平、反共和国家重建的使命！

最后，我要感谢各位今日光临，使我们要增光不少，并希望各位能将真实的中国对贵国所怀有的善意转达给贵国。
